{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem and_left (a b : Bool) (h : (a && b) = true) : a = true := by
  cases a with
  | false => cases h
  | true => rfl

theorem and_right (a b : Bool) (h : (a && b) = true) : b = true := by
  cases a with
  | false => cases h
  | true => cases b with
    | false => cases h
    | true => rfl

theorem or_right (a b : Bool) (h : (a || b) = true) (ha : a = false) : b = true := by
  cases b with
  | false =>
    cases a with
    | false => cases h
    | true => exact absurd ha (fun hh => Bool.noConfusion hh)
  | true => rfl

theorem dec_eq_true (b : Bool) (h : decide (b = true) = true) : b = true := by
  cases b with
  | false => cases h
  | true => rfl

#check @Wallet.acceptedReqs.eq_3
#check @of_decide_eq_true
#check @of_decide_eq_false

end Solution
"}
